authority_used: User instruction to tag every packet with recommended model and reasoning level
changes: Added execution.recommended_model and execution.recommended_reasoning_effort to all 34 RTE remediation packets.
Extended the canonical execution schema for existing Grok/model/estimated_diff metadata and made both recommendation fields mandatory for RTE-TRUTH series packets.
Added the complete routing matrix and mandatory requested-next-step display format to the load plan.
Mirrored packet recommendations into all 34 Task Orchestrator leaf items as model-* and reasoning-* tags plus a readable summary.

validation.command: Draft7Validator over all 34 RTE packet JSON files
validation.summary: All packets parse, contain both recommendation fields, and validate against the canonical schema.
All 34 packet values match the load-plan table exactly; original executor agent/model fields remain unchanged.
The schema rejects unknown routing values and rejects either missing recommendation field on an RTE-TRUTH packet.
All 34 leaf items carry matching model-* and reasoning-* tags; R1-002 readable summary round-tripped.
Aggregate pre-commit failed only because the docs-filename-hygiene system python3 lacks PyYAML.

findings.summary: Recommendation fields were optional in the first schema revision, so future RTE packets could omit them.
findings.resolution: Added a scoped Draft 7 condition requiring both fields whenever series.id starts with RTE-TRUTH-.

residual_risks: Recommended models are policy metadata, not a runtime-enforced scheduler constraint.
Future model families require a canonical schema enum update before packet assignment.

rollback.strategy: Revert the eventual routing metadata commit; orchestrator tags require a matching metadata rollback if the recommendation policy is withdrawn.
